messages:
josh: Short RFC follow-up: proposing a 'multiway attenuation' fallback pattern. Instead of swapping to one fallback, we attenuate baseline weight and spread the lost mass across several fallbacks with an attenuation curve. Goal: smoother quality degradation and predictable tail behavior. Thoughts?

meera: Nice name. Main constraints: need a decision plane off the hot path and a signed compact weight blob for routers. Also need explicit cost/leash in the spec so we don't blow budgets.

kai: Ops notes: require immediate emergency_kill that bypasses attenuation. Also emit audit events for any weight delta > X. Per-variant metrics are required for oncall.

ops-bot: :information_source: canary launched id=cnr-17590 svc=chatgen baseline=v4 window=20m

josh: Implementation idea: an attenuation-broker ingests aggregated telemetry (p50/p95 lat, err_rate, quality_signal), computes an attenuation curve per-route, and publishes {route, weights, gen, ttl, sig} to router pubsub. Router applies only if gen > current and sig valid.

meera: Algorithm sketch: start with small attenuation step (1-2%), apply to baseline, distribute to fallback candidates by preference order, and increase step following a proportional rule capped by quality_budget and cost_cap. Use dwell time to avoid oscillation.

kai: Sticky-session impact: add an "affinity_hold" knob to keep sessions on same variant for N requests to protect KV cache. Also define variant-drain eviction semantics.

josh: Debugging: /attenuation/explain?req=... returns rule trace + brief metric snippets. Also plan a simulator command `platform sim-attenuate --route R --profile P` so SREs can preview.

meera: Ownership: Platform owns spec and broker. Routers are lightweight caches. Add a read-only endpoint for effective-weights and a synchronous emergency_kill flag stored in control plane.

kai: :thumbsup: I'll add runbook bullets: immediate kill steps, rollback checklist, and how to inspect audit events.

josh: I'll produce an RFC addendum with DeploymentSpec fields, pubsub blob format, telemetry contract (lat/err/quality/cost), attenuation algorithm pseudocode, affinity knob, and runbook. Target EOD Wednesday. Ping with gaps.
